source.name: Crystal Palace FC: Crystal Palace Women announce TEN Ltd as new shirt sleeve sponsor
source.note: TEN becomes the women's shirt sleeve sponsor for 2026/27 after two seasons as front-of-shirt sponsor; no value reported.

note: Sleeve sponsorship of Crystal Palace Women from 2026/27; TEN sponsored the women's team for two earlier seasons as front-of-shirt sponsor. No deal values reported.
